completed_milestone: Phase 2 Automation (last phase completed against its original acceptance criteria)
active_task: Phase 10 complete: preflight, staged daily run, derived status, safe mode
known_blockers: No provider is verified on a clean install: the seeded Ollama endpoint is recorded NOT_CONFIGURED until the Owner runs the check, so no model is assignable until then
Research retrieval is off until the Owner lists hosts in STUDIO_RESEARCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS; there is still no search provider, so sources are supplied by URL rather than discovered
No media credentials yet: ElevenLabs and OpenAI image adapters are built and wired, but until the Owner verifies and selects one, renders use placeholder frames and QC blocks them from publication
Independent verification needs two active agents with verified models; with one, the studio refuses to verify rather than letting an agent confirm its own reading
No YouTube OAuth credentials: publishing is disabled by design until a YouTube connection is saved and verified, so Phase 6 acceptance ('private upload verified') is not met
Analytics returns HTTP 503 until a YouTube connection is verified, by design: there is no local substitute for what a platform measured, and nothing is estimated in its absence
Analytics has no UI panel yet; the endpoints are live and the data is empty until a channel is connected
The daily run has no stage implementations connected yet: every stage after the preflight is recorded SKIPPED with that reason, so a run reports PARTIAL rather than a completed day
